title: The Ashen Pass
summary: An ambush at the old shrine.

lines: An abandoned shrine. Of course it's an abandoned shrine.
The lanterns are lit. Someone's here.
Someone heavy. I can feel earth chakra in the ground.
Kagerou said the academy would send its best. He didn't say they'd be children.
There are clones moving in the trees. I'll take them. You take the big one.
You're welcome to borrow my nature. Go!
He's gone. A substitution log. These people love substitution logs.
But he dropped this. A note: "Midnight. The shrine. Bring the scroll's last seal."
The last seal... Then the scroll isn't finished yet.
Then we make sure it never is. Midnight is soon.
